entities.summary: General Vijay Kumar Singh PVSM, AVSM, YSM, ADC is the 16th current governor of Mizoram since 2025, a former member of Parliament, and a former four-star general in the Indian Army. He is former minister of state in the Ministry of Road Transport and Highways and ministry of civil aviation in the Second Modi ministry. He previously served as MoS for External Affairs, Minister of State for Development of the North-Eastern Region and Minister of State for Statistics and Programme Implementation in the First Modi ministry.
